title: JIGSAWS find-it-in-the-recording (VideoTreeSearch-style) QA, for review
source: results/outputs JIGSAWS VTS locate 628 QA blind-filtered - 10-25-2026
how_to_review: Open the trial's video at answer_span and check three things: the answer's span is where the question's thing happens; it is the only place in the recording that answers the question; and the answer says nothing the labels do not record. Set review.ok to true or false and add a comment where needed.

about.format: One question about a whole recording, answered by one stretch of it, as in VideoTreeSearch (arXiv 2607.16189) and the MultiBypass140 locate set. Answers give the time span and what the labels record there; no feedback.
about.filters: Clue at least 3 s and at most 20% of the recording; exactly one answer per recording, verified from the raw labels; any question a guess from its text alone places at IoU >= 0.3 dropped, repeated until none is found.
about.times: minutes:seconds from the start of the video, at 30 fps; frames match the JIGSAWS transcriptions.

kinds.phase: One throw by its number (a stitch, a pass through a ring, a throw of the knot), cut from the gesture labels at each needle transfer.
kinds.step: A gesture the surgeon performs once in the whole recording.
kinds.step in phase: A gesture performed once within one throw.
kinds.step by order: A gesture named by its occurrence ("the second time...").
kinds.event: An executional error that is the only one of its type in the recording (UVA-DSA labels).
kinds.event by order: An executional error named by its occurrence ("the second needle orientation error").
kinds.worst delay: The step furthest over the time the strongest trials take for the same action, by a clear margin over the next; stands in for the MultiBypass140 'worst bleed'.
kinds.redo: The surgeon goes back to an action right after starting the next one.

checks: Exactly one answer per recording: check_locate_qa.py recomputes every question's uniqueness from the raw JIGSAWS transcriptions and UVA-DSA labels; 0 of 628 fail.
No clues in the text: a guess from each question alone, learned from where the same question's answer sits in the other trials, places 0 of 628 at IoU >= 0.3.
Answers: every span matches the labels exactly (628 of 628); every answer to an ordinal question restates the occurrence; every redo answer says it is a return and what came right before it.
Audit: a second model pass checked every answer against its labels and flagged none, after passing a self-test of 11 answers with known verdicts (audit.self_test).
Not checked by any of the above: whether the labels match the video. That is what this review is for.

audit.how: A second pass of the same model reads each answer against the labels it was written from and lists every problem, by rule: 1 time span, 2 what it is, 3 durations, 4 nothing added, 5 answers the question, 6 no 'you'.
